record.body:
## Rationale

The home/main layout stacks content on the left and feels odd, but rethinking the entire screen is a larger product choice. The user asked to discuss that after this phase finishes, so this phase stays inside the phase overlay.

## Counter-argument

Fixing the left-heavy home layout in the same phase would address the broader oddity sooner. Deferred by explicit user request so phase-overview can ship tab chrome first.

payload.alternatives: Include a home/main layout redesign in this phase
payload.choice: Defer rethinking the home/main left-heavy layout until after phase-overview; this phase only improves the phase overlay across all tabs

record.subject: phase-overview-home-layout-defer
